targets.shapeNote: `export default z;` alongside its named exports — a bad named import surfaces as TS2614, not TS2305.
No default export at all — a default import surfaces as TS1192, the mirror image of zod's TS2614.

`export = chalk;` where chalk is `Chalk & ChalkFunction & {...}` — an intersection type with no symbol of its own; a bad property access needs declarationOriginFiles to trace it back. Pinned to v4: v5+ is ESM-only and drops this shape.

Real usage imports from subpaths (firebase/app, firebase/auth, firebase/firestore, ...), not the package root — importMatchesPackage's startsWith(pkg + "/") match is what makes these checkable at all. @sentry/* is the other classic example of this shape.

No bundled types AND no @types/vanta on the registry — genuinely nothing to check against, distinct from lodash's DefinitelyTyped-covered case.
